caption_L1: Here a is a bar graph named U.S. merchandise exports that went to NAFTA countries in 2019 , by industry classification (in billion U.S. dollars). Export value in billion U.S. dollars is shown along the y-axis. On the x-axis, Industry is plotted using a categorical scale from Agricultural products to Transportation equipment.
caption_L2L3: Transport equipment has by far the highest export value at over 100 billion USD, the next highest being computer and electronic products at around 70 billion USD. At less than 20 billion USD, paper has the lowest export value. The majority of exports have value lower than 40 billion USD, almost all of those below 30 billion USD.
